lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then artefacts. Confirmation rating of head 295e953. Fabrics judged as photo-vs-render crops at matched physical scale (17 in = 0.43 m back: q15 hero backs ~205 px vs y_47300 ~122 px, so render crops downsampled x0.62; e4 vs y_47306 ~1:1). Script /tmp/claude-0/raterGB/ms.py (box mean, B/R, L p10/p50/p90, hf = std of L minus 5 px box blur, bright = fraction of L > 1.5 x median, bright-blob count per 1000 px with median / p90 size); ms2.py / ms3.py for close-range boxes. Crops: /tmp/claude-0/raterGB/q15c.png (q15 hero row) and p00c.png (y_47300 hero row, 2x). Lighting and QA camera placement noted, not scored.

priorIssues.issue: w18b-1 / w17b-1 petal fleck too small and faint at row distance

Ground right: #26335c B/R 2.40 L50 47 vs #2d3c66 / #27355c B/R 2.24-2.32 L50 47-53. The cores are back to readable flecks but are still round dots, slightly too many and too soft; photo petals are fewer, bigger, crisper near-white slivers.

issues.title: Headrest cover: single flat value that is too light/grey head-on and too dark close up; no leather sheen
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover: base back toward #262c48 (B/R ~1.85, head-on L50 ~45) and roughness ~0.35-0.40 with a Fresnel / sheen lobe so grazing and close views rise to L ~80-120; reduce the leather grain amplitude by ~70 %.

issues.title: Petal fleck still a shade faint and round at row distance
issues.evidence: q15 s2/s4 (x0.62) vs y_47300: bright 0.128 vs 0.173, p90/p50 1.60 vs 1.88, hf 16 vs 26-30, blob median 2 vs 3 px, count 60 vs 50 per 1000 px. Much better than w18 (bright 0.07-0.09).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py tex_y_fleck: ~15 % fewer flecks, each ~1.4x the area and elongated 1:2-1:3 at random angles, cores L +15 % (toward #c8d2ec), sharper edges; keep the ground (#27355c).

issues.title: Headrest cover tall and overhangs the pad (waits on user)
issues.evidence: q15c.png s2 h/w 0.92, 0.63 of back width vs p00c.png 0.70, 0.58; photo shows pad fabric below the cover.
issues.fix: If y_47300 is the default: shorten the flap ~25 % (end ~1 cm above the pad bottom) and narrow ~8 %.

issues.title: White hood side band ~1.7 cm head-on (photo ~1.2 cm)
issues.evidence: q15 L>170 run 8 px (s1 right, s4 left, y 290-320) at 205 px/back vs y_47300 3-4 px at 122 px/back.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: bring the fabric back edge ~0.5 cm further outboard at hood height, or narrow the hood side wrap by 0.5 cm.

issues.title: Side-panel fabric smears (triplanar blend)
issues.evidence: q18 left seat side, e5 right side, e3 diamond streaks.
issues.fix: Triplanar blend power ~8 for seat fabrics, or lofted UVs on seat sides.

issues.title: Diamond ground greyish, stars soft
issues.fix: Diamond tile B/R +0.25, star edge contrast +25 %.

issues.title: Armrest strut window
issues.evidence: e7 / e1 crossing strut leaves triangular openings; y_47303 solid J plate.
issues.fix: Drop the inner strut or fill the opening with the moulding web.

issues.title: Tick stitches slightly white and long close up; pillow face plain
issues.evidence: e4 tick hf 33 vs 49 with whiter, longer marks than y_47306; pillow hf 1.3 vs 5.7 (y_47300).
issues.fix: Shorten tick marks ~20 %, tint toward #9fb0dc; pillow: fine low-contrast weave and a 5 mm darker piped rim.

issues.title: q16 near seat fabric too light (not scored)
issues.fix: Lighting: another ~-1 stop of fill on the near aisle seats in q16 and less grey cast.

issues.title: Camera mismatches (not scored)
issues.evidence: q15 eye lower and closer than y_47300 (205 vs 122 px backs; armrests and pillows mostly out of frame); q16 looks across the cabin, y_47301 down the left aisle; q17 is a high rear view vs y_47303 window-side profile; q18 further back than y_47305.
issues.fix: Match the cameras to the photos.

questionsForUser: Headrest cover length: y_47300 shows a short flap with pad fabric below it; y_47306 shows it hanging below the pad. Which is the default? The render follows y_47306.
Are the y_47300 headrests raised? The render follows y_47306 (back rises above the pad).
